What happens when there’s no prompt box between you and your AI actors?

Our team stopped by the Neuron to talk about Pika Enact, and how it makes the creation process feel much more immediate and visceral.

https://youtu.be/7ufTrKiOxi0?si=JEhp97IaSr_wj6jq

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Pika megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Pika (@pika_labs); megjelent: 2026-11-18T18:53:56+00:00; link: https://x.com/pika_labs/status/2123127584342921652; média: videó, 150 másodperc]
Today, we’re excited to share Enact, a research preview of scenes that respond to you.

Enact represents a new way of making AI video, one that’s designed to mimic the experience of directing on set. Built on Pika H3 Flex, it allows a creator to interact with “actors,” manually re-stage a scene, and manipulate the camera—all in real time.

We think this is the beginning of a new paradigm for creation. Read more and reach out for a demo below.
